faq.title: Feyshtyn ta cheet dy chadjin roïe toshiaght.
faq.description: Mannagh vel dty haghyrt freggit ayns shoh, oddys co-choyrle cooney dy hiaghey dty hrimshey.
faq.0.question: Cre ny shirveishyn oddys Nocoding y chroo?
faq.0.answer: Ta shin croo ynnydyn-eggey portfolio ny CV pearsoonagh, duillagyn-chroo ny profilyn dellal, reihysyn oaylleeaght as obbyr, as hene-obbrey prosesyn dellal.
faq.1.question: Cre cho liauyr as ta'n troggal goll?
faq.1.answer: Ta portfolio, CV, ny duillag-chroo saoil saaie ayns 1-3 laaghyn-obbyr lurg dy vel y cooid aarloo. Ta pryjeckyn smoo bunnys er graueyn, kiangleyn, as ard y varrey.
faq.2.question: Vel eh abyl dy chaghlaa y dessyn as ny graueyn?
faq.2.answer: Ta. Foddee y dessyn, troggalys ny duillagyn, ny graueyn, as y slee-obbyr ve caghlaait rere dty hrimshey. Ta'n dessyn jeeaghit marish roïe'n troggal goll toshiaght.
faq.3.question: Cre ta goll stiagh ayns y phrey?
faq.3.answer: Ta'n phrey goaill stiagh troggal rere y pagget as ard-obbyr cooïnit. Ta kiarail seyr as ainm-ynnyd son 1 vleïn goll stiagh ayns y phagget Beg, as kiarail seyr as hoastey son 1 vleïn ayns y phagget Mooar.
contact.title: Inshey dooin cre ta dty ynnyd-eggey feme. Ta shin cooney lhiat dy hroggal y raad.
contact.description: Cur dooin giare-hoilshaghey jeh dty ghellal, ny duillagyn t'ou geearree, as y traa t'ou jeeaghyn er. Ta'n chied ghoo goll stiagh coyrleyn mychione ard-obbyr as ny kayrnyn ta cheet. Ta co-choyrle dy kinjagh seyr, tra t'ou feme.

project.description.alengka: Cairt-chooid er-linney jeh vooillyn-stiagh as vooillyn-mooie son thieyn-caffee, thieyn-ee, as thieyn. Foddee jeeaghyn jeeaghyn er y chaglym as taggloo liorish WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Ynnyd-eggey oikoil jeh scoill-hraartey lesh profil scoill, fysseree goaill-stiagh studeyryn noa, rolley ynseyderyn, obbyr-ec-cooyl-scoill, as coyrtyn studeyryn.
project.description.furnix: Cairt-chooid er-linney jeh vooillyn-yiarn veih Jepara son thieyn-caffee, thieyn-ee, as thieyn. Foddee jeeaghyn reih cooid as orderal rere y aigney oc hene.
